<!-- Shared body of each propagation page. Each page sets `branch` and
     includes this file. -->

```{r}
#| include: false
# Use a local biocUniTools checkout if BIOCUNITOOLS_SRC points to one, so
# changes to its R/ show up without reinstalling
src <- Sys.getenv("BIOCUNITOOLS_SRC")
if (nzchar(src)) {
    pkgload::load_all(src, quiet = TRUE)
} else {
    library(biocUniTools)
}
config <- yaml::read_yaml("../config.yml")
data_file <- file.path("..", config$data_dir,
                       sprintf("propagation-%s.rds", branch))
has_data <- file.exists(data_file)
if (has_data) {
    status <- readRDS(data_file)
    bu <- uni_for_bioc(branch)
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!has_data) {
    cat("No data yet. Run",
        "`biocUniTools::write_comparisons(\"reports/config.yml\")`.\n")
} else {
    cat(sprintf("# Propagation: Bioconductor %s (%s)\n\n", bu$bioc_version,
                branch))
    created <- attr(status, "created")
    if (!is.null(created))
        cat(sprintf('<p class="text-body-secondary">Updated %s</p>\n\n',
                    format(created, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")))
    cat(sprintf(paste("Which of %s packages R Universe builds can propagate",
                      "to Bioconductor, by the rules used to harvest them.",
                      "Filter by Type to see one package type.\n\n"),
                format(nrow(status), big.mark = ",")))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (has_data) cat("<details>\n<summary>Summary</summary>\n\n")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) propagation_summary_table(status)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (has_data) cat("\n</details>\n")
```

<details>
<summary>Legend</summary>

A package propagates to a target when it passes every rule for that target.
**Yes** links to the file that would be harvested. Otherwise the table says
**No** and lists the rules it fails; **No** links to the R Universe job that
failed, when a build or check failed.

- **Commit**: the commits R Universe and BBS built. They must be the same for
  a package to propagate.

- **Source** needs a passing R Universe source build (`R CMD build`, which
  builds vignettes), a passing `R CMD check` on Linux x86_64, and the same
  commit as BBS.
- **Windows x86_64 and macOS binaries** need a passing source build, a binary that
  passed `R CMD check` and built, the same commit as BBS, and a platform the
  package supports.
- Bioconductor only distributes binaries of software packages, so binaries
  of other package types show &#8212;.
- **not built**: R Universe has no job for the package on that target.
- **Deprecated** packages can propagate; they are marked so they can be
  skipped.

</details>
